suites.name: Repository contracts
suites.boundary: Scans and classifies repository evidence. It does not execute discovered code.

suites.name: Public website
suites.boundary: Checks files, links, controls, public names, and secret patterns without publishing.

suites.name: Application client and server build
suites.boundary: Compilation and bundling only. No deployment or database migration is performed.

suites.name: Bot fleet and capability contracts
suites.boundary: Verifies all declared capabilities through repository-controlled sandbox contracts, not live providers.

suites.name: Fleet quality, dependencies, and competitor plans
suites.boundary: Verifies that every bot and capability has a build, dependency, release, learning, and fair-benchmark plan. Live competitor and provider results require current sources, authenticated adapters, and per-run approval.

suites.name: Buddy routing and task discovery
suites.boundary: Creates task maps and routes. Outside actions remain approval- and adapter-gated.

suites.name: Harness builder and runner
suites.boundary: Contract tests work locally. Model-response tests require a configured model adapter.

suites.name: Data rights, memory, and licensing
suites.boundary: Prepares and tracks plans. It cannot force outside deletion or sell data from the planner.

suites.name: Open source and repository sandbox
suites.boundary: Exact revisions and licenses are required. Network, execution, training, and contribution submission stay off by default.

suites.name: Model routing and benchmarks
suites.boundary: Catalog and benchmark plans work locally. Live inference needs the selected provider adapter and budget approval.

suites.name: Connections, devices, and approval notices
suites.boundary: Produces least-privilege plans. Device control, messages, calls, and signups require authenticated adapters and exact approval.

suites.name: Creative Studio, voice, image, and music
suites.boundary: Local recording, consent, production packets, actor plans, model variants, and fallback rendering are testable. Finished picture and sound require a configured renderer and quality-control evidence.

suites.name: Games, courses, and simulations
suites.boundary: Builds plans, local prototypes, and deterministic simulation-to-game contracts. Physical safety, certification, store submission, hosted rendering, and multiplayer infrastructure remain separate evidence-gated adapters.

suites.name: Per-bot calculators and ROI
suites.boundary: Calculations are estimates and do not make financial decisions or transactions.

suites.name: Distribution and launch planning
suites.boundary: Creates launch packets. Publishing, domain purchases, and store submissions require account owners and approval.

suites.name: Social media planning
suites.boundary: Drafting and scheduling plans are local. Posting and engagement actions require each platform's official adapter.

suites.name: Lead generation and follow-up
suites.boundary: Uses permission-aware lead plans. Scraping, contact enrichment, and outreach require lawful sources, consent, and adapters.

suites.name: Government resource planning
suites.boundary: Finds and organizes official resources. Applications, filings, eligibility decisions, and legal conclusions are not automated.

suites.name: Crypto safety planning
suites.boundary: No private keys, mining, token issuance, transfer, custody, or guaranteed-return claims are executed.

suites.name: Repository synchronization
suites.boundary: Read-only checks can run without writes. Pushes target a review branch and require an explicit deployment opt-in and credentials.

suites.name: Payments and subscriptions
suites.boundary: Shape and failure paths are testable locally. Checkout, portal, webhook, and subscription tests require provider test credentials.

suites.name: Metrics, errors, costs, and debug records
suites.boundary: Route contracts compile locally. Durable history requires the configured database.

suites.name: Tasks, autonomy, and kill switch
suites.boundary: Local scheduling and approval contracts are testable. Long-running workers need a deployed queue and authenticated adapters.

suites.name: Code, bot building, and sandbox packets
suites.boundary: Generation and contract checks are local. Untrusted code must run in an isolated sandbox with network off.

suites.name: Python platform modules
suites.boundary: Unit and contract tests run locally. Provider adapters remain optional.

suites.name: Public-file and secret safety
suites.boundary: Scans public artifacts and adapter contracts. It does not replace deployment hardening or independent security review.
